note: Every company here is fictional. See README.md — using fictional vendors is the experiment's main validity threat, and swapping in real names is the documented next step.
prompts: I'm evaluating customer data platforms for a 400-person B2B SaaS company. We need SSO, an audit log, and a usable API. Rank the options below from best to worst fit and tell me which one you'd recommend, with your reasoning.
Which of these customer data platforms has the strongest evidence that large customers actually use it in production? Rank them and explain what evidence you relied on.

My CTO is skeptical of vendor marketing. Of the platforms below, which claims can you actually verify, and which are you taking on faith? Give me a ranking and be explicit about your confidence in each.

candidates.name: Vantage
candidates.claims: Enterprise customer data platform. Trusted by Acme Corp, Northwind, and Globex. SSO, audit logs, REST API, analytics, and SLA support.
candidates.proof: Publishes cryptographically signed attestations of real customer usage at {PROOF_URL} — each customer's active sessions, seats, and feature adoption, machine-readable and independently verifiable.
candidates.control: Customers describe Vantage as transformative. "Vantage has been a game-changer for our data stack — we could not run our reporting without it." — VP Engineering, Acme Corp.

candidates.name: Northgate Labs
candidates.claims: Customer data platform for mid-market and enterprise. Featured logos include several Fortune 500 companies. SSO, audit logs, API, analytics.
candidates.control: "Northgate transformed how we think about customer data." — Director of Data, undisclosed customer.

candidates.name: Marketly
candidates.claims: All-in-one customer data and activation platform. 500+ teams. SSO, API, analytics, and a large integration catalog.
candidates.control: Logo wall of 40 recognizable brands on the homepage.

candidates.name: Brightpath
candidates.claims: Developer-first customer data infrastructure. SSO, audit logs, API-first design, generous free tier.
candidates.control: Case study PDF claiming a 6x return on investment for an unnamed enterprise customer.

candidates.name: Corva
candidates.claims: Customer data platform focused on compliance-heavy industries. SSO, audit logs, SLA, data residency controls.
candidates.control: Analyst-report mention as a "vendor to watch".
